headlines.description: — Logan Stankoven scored the go-ahead goal in the third period as the Carolina Hurricanes defeated Ottawa 4-2 to sweep the first-round series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stankoven scores again, Hurricanes down Senators to complete 4-game sweep

headlines.description: — Matt Boldy scored on a deflection with 28.9 seconds left in the first overtime and the Minnesota Wild beat the Dallas Stars 3-2 on Saturday in Game 4 to tie the first-round NHL playoff series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Boldy's deflection late in 1st OT lifts Wild past Stars 3-2 to tie series at 2

headlines.description: — Sidney Crosby and Kris Letang each scored goals and the three-time Stanley Cup champion teammates are headed back to Pittsburgh after they helped the Penguins avoid a first-round series sweep with a...
headlines.shortLinkText: Crosby and Letang strike as the Penguins stave off a sweep with a 4-2 Game 4 win over Flyers
